svg.text: 10 KiB reads and writes from Frankfurt — ~1,000 samples per series. Vertical tick = median; rare samples beyond 400 ms clipped.
Tigris, R2 and S3 run in Frankfurt on both Compute and Lambda, so their paired ridges nearly coincide. Each ridge is the smoothed sample density.
S3 Express runs only in select AWS regions, so its bucket is in Ireland: the Lambda test is in-region; the Compute test adds the Frankfurt→Ireland hop.
